_note: Model ids, display labels, and PER-MODEL effort lists. Efforts are per model because support varies by model -- measured on codex, whose discovery returns ultra for gpt-6-astra but not for gpt-5.6-luna, and neither max nor ultra for gpt-5.5. UNVERIFIED for claude: `claude --help` documents ONE global enum (low, medium, high, xhigh, max) and the CLI does not validate --effort at all (it silently accepts `none` and `ultra`), so no per-model difference could be measured here. Every row therefore carries the full enum. If a model turns out to support fewer, correcting it is a one-line edit to that row -- which is the entire point of this file. NO DEFAULT is declared: claude's default is account-dependent (measured 2026-09-22, `claude -p --output-format json` resolved it to claude-opus-5-5 here), so a shared manifest cannot state one; Crowbar learns the real model from each turn's launch report.
